content.title: Will I be charged with false imprisonment or kidnapping?
content.text: In this video, experienced criminal defense attorney Matthew Wallin explains the difference between false imprisonment under 236 PC and kidnapping under 207 PC. For more information, visit the following pages Kidnapping - 207 PC: https://www.wklaw.com/kidnapping-laws... False Imprisonment - 236 PC/237 PC: https://www.wklaw.com/practice-areas/... Do you know the difference between the crimes of false imprisonment and kidnapping? These two California crimes are similar in many ways, but they involve much different penalties. That is why you need the help of an experienced criminal defense attorney to understand the difference between these crimes and help you defend against kidnapping or false imprisonment charges. Our experienced criminal defense lawyers at Wallin & Klarich have been successfully defending clients accused of serious crimes such as false imprisonment and kidnapping for more than 35 years. We've helped thousands of clients in their time of legal need, and we can help you now. We have offices located in Orange County, Riverside, San Bernardino, Victorville, West Covina, Torrance, Los Angeles and San Diego so that we can help you no matter where you work or live.
